_comment: cUSDC reserve. Underlying = sUSDC (Solstice USD Coin) via the cUSDC native-pool wrapper (KYC-gated, 1:1 wrap, no yield bearing). Replaces the unrestricted sUSDC reserve as the debt asset in EG-1 (stables) + EG-3 (margin long SOL) and as the collateral asset in EG-4 (margin short SOL). The retail sUSDC reserve at 78kkPN…BFy9 is being deprecated — see scripts/deprecate-susdc-reserve.ts and the project memory note.
_oracle_note: cUSDC price = same Pyth USDC feed sUSDC was pegged to (no exchange-rate drift; cUSDC is a 1:1 KYC wrapper). pythConfiguration.price below is the USDC Pyth Receiver price account (PriceUpdateV2 format).
_irm_note: Borrow-rate curve floors at 2.5% APR at 0% utilization (institutional-grade idle yield) and ramps through a soft kink at 80% util / 6% APR before climbing steeply past 90% to discourage 100% utilization. 11-point linearly-interpolated curve as klend requires.

tokenInfo.name: cUSDC
tokenInfo._max_age_note: Set to u64::MAX (== effectively 'never stale') because the devnet Pyth USDC feed is pushed sporadically; a tight 120s/240s window rejects every refresh with PriceTooOld 6039 → empty price_status flags → check_borrow_possible trips ReserveStale 6009. Matches the legacy sUSDC reserve, which has the same value. For mainnet this should drop back to the 60s / 120s window the IRM_NOTES doc recommends.

_eg_note: Lists EVERY elevation group this reserve participates in, whether as debt (EG-1, EG-3) or collateral (EG-4). cSOL uses the same convention: [2, 3, 4] = debt in EG-2 + EG-4, collateral in EG-3. klend's `check_same_elevation_group` rejects a borrow with InconsistentElevationGroup (6068) if the reserve's array doesn't contain the obligation's EG — even on the debt side.
